main.name: Adam Kent
main.description: Always striving to use the best and latest tools for the job. Looking for long-term permanent or contract positions, remote or on site.
main.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer specializing in cloud-native architectures and AI-driven systems. I've worked with organizations including EDF Energy, Centrica (British Gas), Novo Nordisk, Bank of America, and the UK Government. I'm also the editor of smartergovs.org, exploring AI in governance and public sector technology.
main.contactmessage: Please reach out via LinkedIn or the form below.

education.school: University of Liverpool & University of Leeds
education.description: Masters project: AI Classification of Music Genre - Built a Neural Network model classifying music genres using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs).

work.title: Backend & Platform Engineer
work.description: Working on serverless web stacks (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, MySQL). Building full-stack applications with latest TypeScript libraries. Designing APIs (FastAPI, API Gateway) and managing databases with pydantic and alembic. Using design patterns and domain-driven-design.

work.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
work.description: Designed and deployed cloud-native AI-driven systems for EDF Energy, Centrica (British Gas), and Novo Nordisk. Delivered full-stack systems using Python (FastAPI, Flask), React, and Postgres. Built medical imaging tools and AI chat interfaces in production. Created CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure using Terraform and AWS CodePipeline.

work.title: Software Engineer III (AVP) - Commodities
work.description: Maintained risk platform (Brisk, part of Quartz/Athena) for PnL explain tools. Refactored Python-based models backed by Oracle (Sandra). Paired with front-office users for iterative SDLC improvements.

work.company: UK Government: Department of Health & SC
work.title: Data Scientist
work.description: Developed a Python-based informatics system for a new detection assay. Built secure dashboards and managed public health data pipelines. Advocated for scalable, transparent AI use in gov tech.
